clips.title: The story
paras: Cut-Throat Alley is a secluded, unpopulated back corner of Stormwind City hidden away behind the canal shops. Tucked behind a storefront called the Shady Lady near the Dwarven District border, it consists of a quiet courtyard and an empty residence cut off from normal city foot traffic.

Cut-Throat Alley is one of Stormwind's quietest and most secretive corners. Though technically charted alongside the Dwarven District, it shares none of the district's roaring forge fires or heavy soot. The alley cannot be reached from any of the city's main avenues; the only foot path leads straight through the Shady Lady, a small shop lining the canals just south of the bridge from Cathedral Square. Beyond the shop door lies a small paved dead-end lined with stacked crates, forgotten barrels, and a single unoccupied two-story residence. Completely hidden from passing guards and ordinary citizens, it sits entirely silent amidst the bustle of the capital.
